players.sector: Optical Inter-Satellite Links & Space Data Relay
players.product: Tranche 1 optical data relay constellation (SDA-compatible optical terminals) with on-orbit GPU compute and hosted payloads

connects_to.relationship: optical relay network and optical inter-satellite links carrying and connecting Axiom's first two orbital data center nodes (launched Jan 11, 2026)

contracts.source: Axiom Space product page: Orbital Data Centers (10-17-2026)
contracts.signal: Axiom Space: its first two orbital data center nodes launched to low-Earth orbit on January 11, 2026 with the first tranche of Kepler Communications' optical relay network constellation, integrating optical inter-satellite links (2.5 gigabytes per second-capable optical links, compatible with SDA Tranche 1 optical communication standards).
contracts.units: two ODC nodes; 2.5 GB/s-capable optical links

players.product: orbital data center (ODC) nodes - first two launched to LEO on Jan 11, 2026 on Kepler's optical relay network; AxDCU-1 prototype on the ISS

quarterly_data.quarter: Axiom Space product page: Orbital Data Centers (10-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Axiom Space deployed Data Center Unit-1 (AxDCU-1), a data processing prototype powered by Red Hat Device Edge, on the International Space Station in fall 2025 to demonstrate initial ODC capabilities (cloud computing, AI/ML, data fusion, space cybersecurity); Axiom plans to expand its ODC network from kilowatts to megawatts of processing power.
